remaining_findings.title: Google Fonts still loaded via CSS @import
remaining_findings.description: @import blocks CSS parsing and serializes font fetch.
remaining_findings.recommendation: Migrate to next/font for self-hosted fonts. 45 min effort. Risk: CSS variable rename ripples.

remaining_findings.title: Portfolio images still JPG with no pre-optimized WebP siblings
remaining_findings.recommendation: Extend optimize-images.mjs to batch-generate WebP siblings; or flip images.unoptimized to false so Next handles WebP automatically.

remaining_findings.title: Hero video LCP risk unmeasured
remaining_findings.description: Autoplay video on home; file size and poster weight not profiled.
remaining_findings.recommendation: Measure after deploy. If LCP > 2.5s on mobile, gate video behind viewport intersection.

phases.name: Phase 1: Launch prep (today, ≤30 min)
items: Decide on testimonials: remove placeholders OR provide real quotes

Commit everything from today in a clean commit series
Deploy to Vercel (or hosting of choice) with DNS pointing estateframe.digital at the deploy

items: Verify Google Search Console ownership, submit sitemap
Verify Bing Webmaster Tools, submit sitemap
Install Vercel Analytics (zero runtime cost) or Plausible
Flip images.unoptimized to false in next.config.ts
